package nats

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

type diagnosticPublisherCapture struct {
	natsgo.JetStreamContext
	message *natsgo.Msg
	err     error
}

func (capture *diagnosticPublisherCapture) PublishMsg(message *natsgo.Msg, _ ...natsgo.PubOpt) (*natsgo.PubAck, error) {
	capture.message = message
	return &natsgo.PubAck{}, capture.err
}

func TestOutboxPublisherAdmitsOnlyOwnedSubjectsAndPreservesHeaders(t *testing.T) {
	planID := uuid.NewString()
	data := domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedData{PlanID: planID, PlanRevision: 1, PlanDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), ResultDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)}
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(planID), domain.SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted, planID, uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), 1, data)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	capture := &diagnosticPublisherCapture{}
	publisher := &OutboxPublisher{Conn: &natsgo.Conn{}, js: capture}
	if err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), event); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if capture.message.Subject != event.Subject || string(capture.message.Data) != string(event.Payload) || capture.message.Header.Get(natsgo.MsgIdHdr) != event.EventID || capture.message.Header.Get("X-Event-ID") != event.EventID || capture.message.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID") != planID || capture.message.Header.Get("X-Causation-ID") != event.CausationID || capture.message.Header.Get("X-Schema-Version") != "1" {
		t.Fatal("publication lost payload or stable delivery headers")
	}
	capture.err = errors.New("broker unavailable")
	if err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), event); !errors.Is(err, capture.err) {
		t.Fatal("publication ambiguity must remain retryable")
	}
	capture.err = nil
	for _, subject := range []string{domain.SubjectLearningActionClosed, "student.diagnostic-result.committed.v2", "student.mastery.changed", "taskAnswer.started"} {
		candidate := event
		candidate.Subject = subject
		capture.message = nil
		err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), candidate)
		if subject == domain.SubjectLearningActionClosed {
			if err != nil || capture.message == nil {
				t.Fatal("prior closure admission changed")
			}
		} else if err == nil || capture.message != nil {
			t.Fatalf("unowned subject admitted: %s", subject)
		}
	}
	capture.message = nil
	event.Payload = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	if err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), event); err == nil || capture.message != nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed diagnostic envelope reached broker")
	}
}

func TestOutboxPublisherAdmitsPlanningStateFact(t *testing.T) {
	studentID, pathID, identity := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	subject := "student.planning-state.changed.v1"
	eventID := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceURL, []byte(subject+":"+studentID+":"+pathID+":OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE:"+identity)).String()
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(eventID, subject, pathID, identity, studentID, time.Date(2026, 10, 5, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), 1, map[string]any{
		"learning_path_id": pathID, "path_version": int64(2), "trigger_kind": "OBJECTIVE_EVIDENCE", "trigger_identity": identity,
		"targets": []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.loops", Version: "v1"}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	capture := &diagnosticPublisherCapture{}
	publisher := &OutboxPublisher{Conn: &natsgo.Conn{}, js: capture}
	if err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), event); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("committed planning-state fact rejected: %v", err)
	}
	if capture.message == nil || capture.message.Subject != subject || capture.message.Header.Get(natsgo.MsgIdHdr) != eventID {
		t.Fatal("planning fact lost subject/dedupe identity")
	}
	capture.message = nil
	event.Payload = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	if err := publisher.Publish(context.Background(), event); err == nil || capture.message != nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed planning event reached broker")
	}
}
